nuggets.text: Todd Monken, the Browns' first-year head coach, spent 2007 to 2010 coaching wide receivers for the Jaguars.
At Knox College in 1987, Todd Monken shared QB by quarters, playing the second and fourth while a teammate took the first and third.
Todd Monken was Georgia's offensive coordinator for back-to-back national titles in 2021 and 2022.
The Browns have the last two Defensive Rookies of the Year: Jared Verse (2024, with the Rams) and Carson Schwesinger (2025).
Browns cornerback Denzel Ward became an investor in the Cleveland Guardians' ownership group on September 9.
Shedeur Sanders, son of Hall of Famer Deion Sanders, was the first Browns QB picked for the Pro Bowl since Derek Anderson in 2008.
The Browns are the only NFL team without a logo on their helmets.
The Browns are named after their first coach and co-founder, Paul Brown.
The Dawg Pound owes its name to cornerback Hanford Dixon, who dubbed the 1980s Browns defense "The Dawgs."
Rookie Spencer Fano makes his NFL debut at left tackle, and his first assignment is Jaguars pass rusher Josh Hines-Allen.
